description: This file contains the implementation of the GeneralLedgerServices class, providing services related to creating or updating cost centers and calculating total amounts in the context of general ledger management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GeneralLedgerServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for managing general ledger activities like creating or updating cost centers and calculating totals in OFBiz.

methods.name: createUpdateCostCenter
methods.description: Creates or updates cost center details based on provided context; runs a synchronous service call for each cost center category, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: calculateCostCenterTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount percentage from a map of categories and values.
